def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    loan_amount = 250000
    annual_interest_rate = 0.0375
    loan_term_years = 30
    monthly_interest_rate = annual_interest_rate / 12
    number_of_payments = loan_term_years * 12

    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    monthly_payment = loan_amount * monthly_interest_rate / (
        1 - (1 + monthly_interest_rate) ** -number_of_payments
    )
    remaining_balance = loan_amount

    for _ in range(12):
        interest_payment = remaining_balance * monthly_interest_rate
        principal_payment = monthly_payment - interest_payment
        remaining_balance -= principal_payment

    principal_paid = loan_amount - remaining_balance

    # Return the answer rounded to the nearest dollar
    return round(principal_paid)
